findings.passage: “Data shows us that if this language is incorporated into Indiana code, we could expect unintentional firearm deaths and suicides among children to decrease by a third,” Gore said.
findings.note: Quoted by WFYI/Indiana Public Radio, speaking for his floor amendment requiring gun owners to secure firearms from children; the amendment was ruled not germane to HB 1077.
subjects: safe storage of guns around children

findings.motion: Floor amendment to HB 1077 (handgun license repeal) making it a crime to fail to secure a firearm a child then accesses; ruled not germane
findings.note: Gore authored the amendment; the outlet reports it would require locking the gun in a container, using a trigger or cable lock, or disassembling it.
subjects: safe storage of guns around children

findings.passage: “The idea, of course, is to prevent these tragedies that we’re seeing more and more where children access an unsecured firearm and then use it to injure themselves or another,” Gore said.
findings.note: Quoted by WFYI/Indiana Public Radio on reviving his safe storage bill.
subjects: safe storage of guns around children

findings.passage: “We attempted to introduce it as an amendment to permitless carry or license-less carry,” Gore said about the most recent attempt. “I thought it’d be a good amendment to show that we’re serious about gun owner’s rights but we’re also serious about their responsibilities.”
findings.note: Quoted by WFYI/Indiana Public Radio, describing his storage amendment offered on the permitless carry bill.
subjects: safe storage of guns around children

findings.passage: “In Cumberland, I’ve had conversations with the (police) chief about the toll this takes on law enforcement and other first responders,” Gore said. “It’s just tragic and I’m really, really sick of having to hear about this occurring throughout the state… I think it’s time for it to end and I think it’s common sense.”
findings.note: Quoted by WFYI/Indiana Public Radio on child shootings with unsecured guns.
